name: Ocean Deep
pitch: The child pilots a bubble submarine with a sea turtle co-pilot to rescue a whale calf tangled in an old fishing net.
setting: Coralcove, a glowing reef town with kelp forests, a sunken teacup ship, and lanternfish streetlights

supportingCast.name: Shelby
supportingCast.look: wise green sea turtle wearing round diving goggles

supportingCast.name: Nudge
supportingCast.look: baby blue whale with a white belly and a big gentle grin

supportingCast.name: The Puffer Twins
supportingCast.look: two spotty yellow pufferfish who puff up when they giggle

contentRules: no sharks or scary sea creatures

starters.title: Nudge and the Old Net
starters.idea: Nudge the whale calf is tangled in an old fishing net. Pulling makes the knot tighter and the Puffer Twins puff up and get stuck too. The child notices one loose loop, the team unthreads it one loop at a time, and Nudge's family sings them home.

starters.title: The Reef That Lost Its Light
starters.idea: The glowing reef has gone dark and the little fish can't find their way. The submarine's lights scare them and shouting only makes it worse. The child remembers the glowing creatures sleep when it is noisy; everyone goes quiet, the reef glows again, and the fish swim home.
